headline: Safe Routes to School findings, Shelburne Road pedestrian safety proposal, and East District forum recommendations.
summary: The meeting covers a Safe Routes to School report and Department of Public Works updates. It also includes a proposal to make Shelburne Road safer for pedestrians and a list of recommendations from the East District forum.
items: Safe Routes to School: Jack Evans presents findings from a conference (15 min)
Department of Public Works updates on E-motos, Main Street multimodal, and planBTV 2050 (15 min)
Shelburne Road proposal to make pedestrians safer (10 min)
East District Retrospective: combine forum notes into recommendations for Burlington's city council (40 min)
location: DPW conference room at 645 Pine Street, or virtually on Zoom
